name: ValleyMoonNoShadow
description: A low raking moon for landscape. Terrain has no silhouette of its own at close range -- what tells you a hillside is a hillside is the difference between its lit and shadowed flanks, and a high key flattens exactly that. The key sits at 17 degrees so ridges throw long shadows down the slopes behind them, and the fill is a broad cool sky term at a fifth of the key so the shadowed flanks stay readable instead of going to black.
